entries.14b615072be2bce8: A segment covering general merchandise stores, uniform-price variety goods retailing and similar businesses. It is a store format that sells food, clothing, and housing and leisure goods together in one store, and is carried out by AEON Retail Co., Ltd., AEON Hokkaido Corporation, AEON Kyushu Co., Ltd., AEON Tohoku Co., Ltd., AEON Ryukyu Co., Ltd., Fuji Co., Ltd., CanDo Co., Ltd. and others. Operating revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥3,604,875 million, the largest of the 9 business segments. Segment profit, however, was ¥21,430 million, so profit is not as large as its rank in operating revenue. The company explains that higher merchandise costs from rising raw material prices and higher costs of investment in people, including wage increases, weighed on profit.

entries.41a942c779ebacd1: A segment covering the mobile marketing business, the digital business and others. It is presented not as a reportable segment but as the "Other Businesses segment." For the fiscal year ended February 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥25,403 million, and capital expenditure of ¥37,916 million was made in the digital business and others. The segment loss was ¥14,134 million. The Group's common app "iAEON" has about 22 million downloads and brings together functions such as "payment," "points," "coupons" and "electronic receipts."

entries.584dd8b2d990d2d6: A segment covering supermarkets, convenience stores and small supermarkets. It is carried out by United Super Markets Holdings Inc. (with Kasumi Co., Ltd., Maruetsu, Inc. and Inageya Co., Ltd. under it), Maxvalu Tokai Co., Ltd., Daiei, Inc., Koyo Co., Ltd., MINISTOP Co., Ltd., My Basket Co., Ltd. and others. Operating revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥3,070,400 million and segment profit was ¥29,870 million. My Basket Co., Ltd. opened 129 stores during the fiscal year, bringing its number of stores at the end of the year to 1,323. Sales of convenience store franchisees (¥237,797 million in the fiscal year) are not included in this segment's operating revenue.
entries.5c3c84ddcf565286: A segment covering drugstores, dispensing pharmacies and similar businesses. It includes Welcia Holdings Co., Ltd. and Tsuruha Holdings Inc., which became a consolidated subsidiary on January 14, 2026. Operating revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,632,463 million (123.5% of the previous year), and segment profit was ¥52,368 million, an increase of ¥16,361 million from the previous year. Segment assets were ¥1,410,529 million, 2.3 times the previous year's amount. The number of directly operated stores of the Tsuruha Group, after 117 new openings and 90 closures plus an increase of 2,991 stores from the integration, was 5,676 at the end of the fiscal year. The company positions this business as the core of its growth.

entries.62451c0cfb646ea5: A segment covering the development and leasing of shopping centers. It is centered on AEON Mall Co., Ltd., which became a wholly owned subsidiary through a share exchange on July 1, 2025; it develops malls in Japan and overseas and earns rent by leasing spaces to specialty stores. For the fiscal year ended February 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥431,506 million and segment profit was ¥70,916 million, making it the largest of the 9 segments by profit. It ranks 7th by operating revenue but 1st by profit. In Japan, 21 malls were renovated during the year, and specialty store sales at the renovated malls were 109.1% of the previous year, exceeding those at malls without renovation.

entries.af1f86aa90a1476a: A segment covering discount stores. It is carried out by AEON BIG Co., Ltd. and Big-A Co., Ltd., which operate stores built around EDLP (Every Day Low Price), selling at the same low prices every day. For the fiscal year ended February 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥429,219 million and segment profit was ¥7,233 million. Big-A Co., Ltd. completed the unification of the former Acore stores under the Big-A name during the year.
entries.af57596a9280651a: A segment covering retail businesses in the ASEAN region and China. It is carried out by AEON CO.(M) BHD. (Malaysia), AEON VIETNAM CO.,LTD. (Vietnam), AEON STORES(HONG KONG)CO.,LTD., AEON(HUNAN)Co.,Ltd., AEON(HUBEI)CO.,LTD. and others, and the consolidated period is mainly January to December. Operating revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥563,599 million and segment profit was ¥10,228 million. The company positions Vietnam, which is in a demographic dividend period and has a high propensity to consume, as its most important market, and says it will pursue dominant store openings in the south and north as well as in surrounding cities centered on the central region.

entries.c3827014d8baa779: A segment covering the credit card business, fee business and banking. It is centered on AEON Financial Service Co., Ltd. and AEON Bank, Ltd., and operates not only in Japan but also in Greater China, the Mekong region and the Malay region. For the fiscal year ended February 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥486,237 million and segment profit was ¥60,871 million, making it the 2nd largest of the 9 segments by profit. Segment assets were ¥8,306,171 million, accounting for more than half of consolidated total assets of ¥15,369,658 million. At fiscal year-end, AEON Bank, Ltd.'s deposit balance was ¥5,464,167 million, and the number of active domestic IDs was 39.25 million.
